explication: React is a UI library whose principal workflow turns component source into rendered, interactive output. This repository also contains a Rust/TypeScript optimizing compiler, server-rendering adapters, React Server Components transport, an external-store compatibility hook, and DevTools integrations. The compiler excerpts show lowering, validation, inference, reactive-scope construction, optimization, and code generation. Several runtime and DevTools subsystems are represented by enclosing directories because their implementation files were not sampled; wiring is therefore intentionally conservative.
